added_lines: deaths during the past week we extend our sympathies to the families of: william twomey – banduff patrick (paddy) murphy - mayfield may their souls rest in peace. amen second collection this sunday the 2nd collection is mission sunday collection. as always, we thank you for your kind generosity. baptisms in our family of parishes. our lady crowned church 1st sunday of every month at 1.00pm 3rd saturday of every month at 3.00pm. st joseph’s church – mayfield 3rd saturday of every month at 4.00pm baptism preparation meetings with families on saturday 18th october at 12noon on saturday 15th november at 12noon on saturday 13th december at 12noon at our lady crowned church. all parents presenting children for baptism are requested to attend baptism preparation meetings. family of parishes adoration of the blessed sacrament at st. joseph's mayfield from 10.45am to 5.00pm each day on mondays and tuesdays. new adorers invited. st joseph’s church – mayfield adoration: adoration of the blessed sacrament at st. joseph's mayfield from 10.45am to 5.00pm each day on mondays and tuesdays. new adorers invited. rosary: rosary at 5.30pm every saturday before the 6.00pm mass. all are welcome. legion of mary: every monday 7.30pm. new members welcome our lady crowned church – mayfield christian mediation: every tuesday after the 9.30am mass. rosary: each morning at 9.00am legion of mary: every tuesday after the 9.30am mass. new members welcome confessions: every friday after the 9.30am mass funeral ministry team our funeral ministry team lead prayers at our local funeral homes. pastoral council meeting joint meeting of our lady crowned church, st joseph’s church and holy family church will take place on this monday 20th october at 7.00pm at our lady crowned church. november – holy souls novena 2025 envelopes and lists are now available in our churches. annual remembrance masses 2025 this year our remembrance masses will take place saturday 8th and sunday 9th november in our three churches. discernment group meetings for men interested in the diocesan priesthood a series of monthly gatherings will take place for men aged between 18 and 40 who are considering the diocesan priesthood. each month at these gatherings there will be an opportunity for input, time of reflection and prayer. if you are interested, further information and registration can be obtained by emailing fr cian o’sullivan on
vocations@corkandross.org

altar servers during this month of october, we are inviting girls and boys from 3rd class upwards to become altar servers in our 3 churches. we are asking all parents to encourage their children to consider the ministry of altar server. full training will be given. contact fr charlie on
